LanguageData.StellarisShipSnapshotFailed: Failed to save the ship snapshot. Travel cancelled.

LanguageData.StellarisArrivedAtPlanet: The ship has arrived in orbit of {0}. Travel took {1} years.
LanguageData.Stellaris_ArchaeologySiteScanFound: {0} completed an orbital scan and found an archaeological site on the current planet.
LanguageData.Stellaris_ArchaeologyTargetCompleted: This target has already been reverse-engineered.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorShutdownDesc: Perform a controlled shutdown. Shutdown takes about {0}; the reactor gradually reduces output, and it can still trigger a containment breach if destroyed before shutdown completes.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorStartDesc: Begin reactor startup. Startup takes about {0}; output rises gradually as the magnetic containment stabilizes, and the reactor can still fail catastrophically if breached during startup.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachLetterText: The reactor has shut down, but the plasma chamber and fuel system are failing in sequence. Expect a main containment burst, plasma venting, a strong EMP, fuel-system cookoff, and vitrified ground.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachCriticalDam: A running fusion reactor has suffered critical damage. Its magnetic containment is collapsing.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachDestroyed: A running fusion reactor has been destroyed. Its containment chamber is out of control.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage0: The fusion reactor containment structure is collapsing. Sequential failure is about to begin.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage1: The main containment chamber ruptures, tearing through the reactor hall with superheated plasma.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage2: Residual plasma vents through broken conduits, causing multiple secondary bursts.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage3: Broken superconducting coils discharge a strong EMP, blacking out nearby electronics.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage4: Cryogenic fuel cells depressurize in sequence, causing fuel-system cookoff beneath the reactor base.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage4NoFue: The reactor fuel system was empty, preventing an additional fuel cookoff.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorBreachStage5: Concrete and ceramics at the accident center vitrify, leaving activated metal debris across the site.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorStartingDesc: The reactor is warming up and establishing magnetic containment. Current progress: {0}.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorShuttingDownDesc: The reactor is reducing power and cooling down under control. Current progress: {0}.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorTransitionBusy: The reactor is already executing a startup or shutdown sequence and cannot switch instantly.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorStartupStarted: Fusion reactor startup has begun. Warmup and magnetic containment setup will take about {0}.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionReactorShutdownStarted: Fusion reactor controlled shutdown has begun. Power-down and cooldown will take about {0}.
LanguageData.Stellaris_ResearchRequiresUnknownArchaeo: Requires analyzing the corresponding archaeology blueprint.
LanguageData.Stellaris_AnalyzeFusionReactorBlueprintD: Enter this archaeology blueprint into the colony research database, making the fusion reactor research project available. The blueprint will be consumed as core technical data.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionResearchAlreadyFinished: Fusion reactor research is already finished.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionBlueprintAlreadyAnalyzed: The fusion reactor blueprint has already been analyzed.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionResearchManagerMissing: Could not access the Stellaris research unlock manager.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionBlueprintAnalyzedMessage: Complete fusion reactor blueprint analyzed. Fusion reactor research can now begin.
LanguageData.Stellaris_FusionBlueprintInspectableUnlo: Can be analyzed: unlocks fusion reactor research.
